product.title: Scenic Full Day Circle Island Tour-Snorkeling/Breakfast/Byodo-in

description.text: This small-group circle-island tour picks up early from Waikiki hotels and includes Byodo-In Temple. Named lookouts include Diamond Head Lookout and the Halona Blowhole. Breakfast is a burrito, temple admission is included, and a local guide comments on the culture. Drop-off returns to Waikiki. The burrito, the temple admission, and those two lookouts are part of the early small-group ride on Oahu. A local guide, the breakfast burrito, and Byodo-In admission accompany the early Waikiki pickup on this small-group Oahu ride.
